QuestInfo.name: For Wont of Glasses
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1092006##k wants you to help #b#p1094001##k on an important job. #b#p1094001##k is supposed to be really talented... Are the rumors true?
QuestInfo.1: THIS is the great #b#p1094001##k? He's crawling around on the floor looking for his glasses! He thinks they were stolen by the #r#o1220001#es#k. Looks like your mission is to get them back...
QuestInfo.2: You found #b#p1094001##k's glasses. Amazing the difference a pair of glasses makes!

0.0: Sorry, but could you do me a little favor? I'm helpless without them, so could you look around for my glasses?

yes.0: I took off my glasses to wipe sweat off my face, but I dropped them... The #r#o1220001##k must've run off with them. They love anything shiny, you know.
yes.1: Eliminate the #r#o1220001##k around here, and I bet you'll find them. Okay, I'm counting on you!

no.0: Shoot... Okay, I understand. They've got to be around here somewhere...

1.0: Found them? Let me see. I sure hope these are mine...

yes.0: These are mine all right! Thanks a lot.

item.0: I'm telling you, the #r#o1220001##k are behind this. Please find my glasses!
